print('ONLINE_STATUS',d.get('status'),'API_SOURCE',d.get('api_source'),'ACCOUNT_COUNT',len(d.get('accounts',[])),flush=True)

 print('ACCOUNT',i,'CONNECTED',item.get('connected'),'AUTHORIZED',item.get('authorized'),'IDENTITY',item.get('identity_verified'),'PHONE_MATCH',item.get('phone_matches'),flush=True)
 assert all(item.get(k) is True for k in ('connected','authorized','identity_verified','phone_matches'))
